evaluation_policy.latency_contract: All variants produce output_valid at the same externally visible cycle as the golden implementation (16 active cycles after acceptance).
evaluation_policy.architecture_tradeoff: Unroll factor trades fewer active compute cycles for a deeper combinational datapath; response is deliberately padded to preserve strict cycle-accurate EQY.
evaluation_policy.selection_rule: Only candidates passing every mandatory gate and timing feasibility may be ranked.
evaluation_policy.evidence_scope: Pre-layout Liberty mapping and ideal-clock STA; not routed PPA or power.
